value.value: Isotropic ADPs vary independently and become high; the authors attribute this to limited q-range, background, signal-to-noise and temperature. Antisite defects and interstitial Zn at (0,0,0) are refined under Zn/Al stoichiometry constraints. The complete refined values are in unavailable Table S7. This formula/site reference is not a complete coordinate set or a qualified measured CIF.
